_comment: Report/export audit log. Phase 12. Every export — board narrative, assurance pack, or a raw KPI/incident/CAPA/audit/evidence-map/framework-readiness dump — writes exactly one row here via recordExport() in functions/shared/services/report-service.ts, in addition to the usual AuditTrail entry. Kept as its own table (rather than folded into AuditTrail) because exports carry filters and a record count that don't fit the generic audit-entry shape.
